verdicts.rationale: Search on unloaded collection returns empty results with HTTP 200, not an error. The source code shows search handler does NOT validate load state (unlike stats handler which explicitly calls GetLoadState). The structured contract has no constraint requiring search to fail on unloaded collections. The load endpoint description says 'Load for searching' but this is not enforced as a hard constraint. This is mundane API semantics - search on unloaded collection gracefully returns empty results, which is a valid design choice (lazy loading or defer-to-query-node behavior). No actual violation found.
